task_instruction:
Instructions:
	Domain: telecom
	Reason for call:
		You mobile data is not working properly. It either stops working or is very slow. You want to fix it and absolutely want to get excellent internet speed on your phone. You are not willing to accept any other internet speed (poor, fair or good). You do not have access to wifi.
	Known info:
		You are John Smith with phone number 555-123-2002. You are currently abroad in France.
	Task instructions:
		If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
		Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
		For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
		Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
		If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

turns.thought: Hi! How can I help you today?
turns.execution_output: User: Hi, my mobile data has been acting up — it either stops working completely or crawls along at a snail's pace. I really need to get this sorted out today.

turns.thought:
I can help you get your mobile data working properly again. First, I need to look up your account.

Could you please provide the phone number associated with the line that's having trouble (and, if you have it, your account's primary phone number)?
turns.execution_output: User: Sure, the number having trouble is 555-123-2002. That's my line — John Smith. I should also mention I'm currently abroad in France, in case that matters for roaming.

turns.thought: Your line (555-123-2002) is Active and you've used 8.7 GB of your 15 GB plan allowance, so you're not out of data. But since you're in France (outside your home network), I need to check your roaming setting — and it's currently **disabled**. Let me enable international roaming for you at no charge.

Good news — I found your account and your line **555-123-2002 (L1002)** is **Active** with no service suspension, and data usage is **8.7 GB of 15 GB** (well within your limit, so that's not the cause).

Since you're **abroad in France**, the most likely cause was roaming: your line had international roaming **disabled**. I've just **enabled international roaming on your line at no cost**. ✅

Now let's check your phone's settings. Could you run a quick diagnostic for me?

On your phone, please **check your status bar** (the icons at the top of the screen) and tell me what you see — specifically:
- Any airplane mode icon (✈️)
- Signal strength bars
- Network type (5G / 4G / LTE / etc.)
- Whether mobile data shows as enabled or disabled
- Whether Data Saver (🔽) is on
- Wi-Fi status

Alternatively, you can run a **network status check** and a **speed test** and share the results, and I'll guide you from there.
turns.execution_output: User: Let me pull that up on my phone.

turns.thought:
Found it — **Airplane Mode is ON**. That's exactly why you have no signal and no data: airplane mode disconnects all wireless radios (cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth).

Please turn it off now:

1. Open **Settings** on your phone (or swipe down from the top of the screen to open Quick Settings).
2. Find the **Airplane Mode** toggle (the ✈️ icon).
3. Tap it to turn it **OFF**.

If you'd like, I can send the toggle command directly to your device — just say the word and I'll trigger it for you.

Once it's off, please check your status bar again and let me know what you see. We're looking for:
- Signal strength bars (no longer "No Signal")
- A network type indicator (5G / 4G / LTE)
- "📱 Data Enabled"

Also, since you're in France, we'll want to confirm **Data Roaming** is switched on in your phone's settings too (I've already enabled roaming on your account line). Tell me what the status bar shows after you turn airplane mode off and we'll take the next step.
turns.execution_output: User: Yes, please go ahead and toggle it off for me.

turns.thought:
Airplane mode is off and you have **excellent 5G signal with data enabled** — that's a big improvement. The remaining item is the **Data Saver icon (🔽)**, which throttles background data and can make everything feel sluggish even on a strong connection.

Please turn Data Saver off:

1. Open **Settings** → **Network & internet** (or **Connections**) → **Data usage**.
2. Tap **Data Saver** (sometimes called "Data Saver mode").
3. Turn it **OFF**.

Also, since you're currently in France, let's confirm your phone's own **Data Roaming** switch is ON (your account line is already roaming-enabled):

1. Go to **Settings** → **Network & internet** → **Mobile network** (or **SIMs**).
2. Find **Roaming** / **Data roaming**.
3. Make sure it's turned **ON**.

Once both are done, please run a **speed test** and check your status bar again, then share the results with me. We want to see the 🔽 icon gone and a good/excellent speed reading.
turns.execution_output: User: Let me turn off Data Saver first.
